source: NASA Baseline Values and Assumptions Document (BVAD, NASA/TP-2015-218570)

subsystem_checklist.name: Radiation Shielding Envelope
subsystem_checklist.required: Minimum 20 g/cm² hydrogenous mass or regolith overburden against GCR HZE flux

subsystem_checklist.name: Atmospheric Pressure & Composition
subsystem_checklist.required: 101.3 kPa (or 70.3 kPa 30% O2) with N2 buffer gas to prevent hyperoxic pulmonary atelectasis

subsystem_checklist.name: Closed-Loop ECLSS Sabatier Reactor
subsystem_checklist.required: Catalytic hydrogenation of CO2 (CO2 + 4H2 -> CH4 + 2H2O) + methane pyrolysis

subsystem_checklist.name: Bioregenerative Hydroponic Growth Chambers
subsystem_checklist.required: Photosynthetic photon flux density >300 umol/m2/s for fresh leafy greens and micro-nutrient replenishment

subsystem_checklist.name: Thermal Control Radiator Loops
subsystem_checklist.required: Ammonia heat exchanger loops rejecting internal metabolic and electrical heat to deep space
